description: Controls recursion during sourcetree operations. If present, a fetched dependency is checked for its own sourcetree config.
Places a dependency into the local stash folder, ensuring it is fetched only once.
Excludes a config entry from the actual sync process, useful for system libraries.
If disabled (no-readwrite), the dependency will be write-protected to prevent accidental edits.
If disabled (no-delete), a dependency cannot be deleted or moved by the sync.
If disabled (no-update), a dependency does not take part in the sync process.
If a dependency marked 'require' cannot be fetched, the sync will fail.
If disabled (no-bequeath), recursion is stopped for any entry not in the top-most config.
Filters dependencies based on the target platform (e.g., no-platform-linux).
Specifies a minimum version for a dependency.
Specifies a maximum version for a dependency.
If disabled (no-static-link), dependencies are treated as dynamic (shared) libraries.
Marks a library as a standalone library, often an agglomeration of multiple single libraries.
If disabled (no-dependency), entries do not partake in linkorder output under certain conditions.
If disabled (no-intermediate-link), affects linking behavior.
If disabled (no-dynamic-link), a dependency or library can only be statically linked.
If disabled (no-actual-link), affects linking behavior.
If disabled (no-actual-build), the node is still traversed for its subdependencies but is not built itself. Use for dependency convenience wrappers.
If disabled (no-build), the dependency will not be built.
Forces serial compilation of a dependency.
A specialized, possibly deprecated, flag for subprojects.
Filters dependencies based on the SDK to be built with (e.g., no-sdk-iphoneos).
If enabled, inplace builds forego the dispense phase, installing directly to the dependency folder.
Indicates that a dependency (usually an Objective-C library) needs to be linked in a special way to prevent symbol optimization.
If disabled (no-rootheader), a subdirectory is created in dependency/include for header files.
If enabled (only-liftheaders), header files are moved up one directory level from their subdirectories.
Used by mulle-sourcetree-to-c to generate header files.

Used by mulle-sourcetree-to-c to generate header files.
Controls whether a dependency is symlinked or copied.
If disabled (no-clobber), an existing file at the destination will not be overwritten.
If disabled (no-fetch), the dependency will not be fetched.
A mark to handle amalgamated dependencies and prevent redundant fetches.
Uses the basename of the address for comparison.
Library that needs all symbols (ObjC).
Add to the list of libraries to link.
Inherit anything from a foreign library.
Prefix container name with STARTUP_.
The header must exist.
The library must exist.
If disabled (no-cmake-suppress-system-path), system paths are not suppressed during search.
Indicates that a dependency should be linked.
Indicates that a dependency is a framework.
